transport.notes: This model has a transport capacity of 30 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED models. Each JUMP PACK, WULFEN, GRAVIS or TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 models. Each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 models. Each MOUNTED model takes up the space of 4 models.
